_about: The Magic Portals port's movers. `oscillation` is the Godot project's guess, carried from
behaviours.gd so it can be retuned without touching code (Enhanced's own CLAUDE.md rule 1).
`lift`, `button` and `door` are decoded; `button` and `door` are read by sim/Puzzle rather
steps 4, 78, 133 and 140: `door` is step 133's, and `lift` is step 140's, which replaced
the Godot project's self-running shuttle and its guessed 120 px/s.

_note: RATE_SCALE_K (behaviours.gd:22-26). An oscillating mover - a moving platform, a
patrolling no-portal zone - swings by sin(rate_scale * speed * t) * stride / 2 about
where the level places it. `speed` is a frequency: across the moving_platform
placements speed x stride clusters in a narrow band while each alone varies widely.
The absolute scale is the Godot project's guess; the bytecode constant is not decoded.

_source: ETHCallback_lift (ETHCallback_lift.angelscript, listing L83504, bytes 409098..410697) and
sendLiftToOtherPoint (the same file, L83903, 410697..411544), in Enhanced's
out/parity/asbc/all_functions.txt (md5 48fe65ce8baea16b94ed84d8d7be84b0; 00_order 8.0: a call
pushes its last argument first). lift.ent (entities/lift.ent) is static=1, so the callback runs
only while the lift's bucket is on the view (00_order 8.12c). Both spellings, lift and lift.ent,
run it (ETHASUtil.cpp:63-67); entity_roles.json gives both the role `lift`.
THE FIRST FRAME (#1-176, while the entity has no 'dest'): the entities its strings 'a' and 'b' name
are found (SeekEntity) and their points kept as 'a' and 'b'; the lift is PUT ON 'a' (#84-90
SetPositionXY(a)); 'dest' = 'origin' = a; 'squaredDistance' = |b - a|^2; 'nonTeleportable' 1; and
both markers are deleted. So it starts at rest on its marker a (in all 14 placements the node
already stands there: test_mp_movers' census).
EVERY FRAME, NOT PAUSED (#177-262): getTouchStateInRect(GetPositionXY() - GetCameraPos(), GetSize(),
vector2(0.5, 0.5), touchPos) (TouchInputManager 159915..160369: the first touch whose RAW state is
not up and whose point lies in the rect of the entity's size centred on its point, both edges in,
isPointInRect) == 1, GSKS_HIT (KeyStateManager.h:31) - the frame a touch goes down on it - and
_screenPad.isValidPoint(touchPos) (149925..150004: not on a walk pad). Then every touch is
disabled (#234-251, disableTouch for t < GetMaxTouchCount: TouchInputManager::getTouchState reads
0 until the touch is up again, 161450..161662 and update #155-165), so the portal manager fires
nothing on its release; sendLiftToOtherPoint(this) (#258, its only caller) and
g_audioManager.playElevatorSound() (#262: PlaySample(g_sfxNames[13]), elevator.mp3; sounds.json).
sendLiftToOtherPoint: at 'a' (vector2 opEquals on its point) -> 'dest' b, 'origin' a; else at 'b'
-> 'dest' a, 'origin' b; ELSE, anywhere between -> 'origin' b, 'dest' a: a tap on a moving lift
sends it back toward a whichever way it was going. Then 'dir' = normalize(dest - its point).
THE MOVE (#263-321): while 'dest' != its point, AddToPositionXY(scaledUnitsPerSecond(dir x speed))
with the local speed SET TO THE LITERAL 60 (#286 SetV4 1114636288 = 60f) - scaledUnitsPerSecond
(STimeManager 8363..8483 and 8284..8363) is unitsPerSecond x getScale(), 60 of the level's units a
second (speed_units_per_s). The callback reads NO 'speed' datum: 2-02's lift_789 carries speed 120,
which nothing in the listing reads, so every lift runs at 60. Then (#322-367) when
squaredDistance(origin, its point) >= 'squaredDistance' it is put on 'dest': it arrives exactly,
and stays until the next tap. Nothing plays on arrival.
THE BLINK (#368-393), every frame whatever it is doing: blinkColor(this, _blinkColorA, _blinkColorB,
1, 1) - so 0.6 grey at 0 ms, white at 300, grey at 600 (blinkColor: art.json antiportal's _source,
utilEntityEffect 326140..326616; its clock blinkElapsedTime from the first call). lift.ent's
emissive (1, 1, 1) keeps min(1, ambient + emissive) whole, so the full swing shows.
size_units: GetSize() is the sprite's frame times its scale: lift.png is 64 x 32 with no hd twin,
lift.ent SpriteCut 1 x 1 and Scale 1, and no level node scales or turns a lift (its collision box
is 62 x 32; the touch is tested against the picture's rect).

_note: A pressed button SINKS, and nothing else about it changes: no colour, scale, frame,
sprite, sound or particle (D10's negative result over all 437 instructions of the
four functions). Its `stride` is the node's - 300 in every one of the 46 placements,
and button.ent's own default - so it is not here.
The 6 is in .esc units, and the port takes 1 .esc unit for 1 port unit. INFERRED:
00_order.md:152 measures scale(7) as +6.83 u, a ratio of 0.976, which would make the
original's own sink about 5.86 u. The visuals plan's gates (6.0 +- 0.25 u at 300 ms,
4.24 +- 0.3 u at 150 ms) are written to hold either way: do not tighten them without
re-measuring that ratio.
_source: computeButtonInterpolator (android_game.bin 414627..415192) and ETHCallback_button,
ETHBeginContactCallback_button, ETHEndContactCallback_button (415192..416591), decoded
in out/parity/visuals/briefs/decode/D10.md and confirmed by D10_check.md:
#39 @414745  PshC4 6.0f, then g_scale.scale(6.0) (SGlobalScale::scale 5809 #3-5)
#44-47       vector2(0, scale(6)): the 6 is pushed first, so it is y
#48-60       pressedPos = originalPos + multiply(that, rotateZ(GetAngle())); every
one of the 46 placements has angle 0, so it is straight down
#74-92       PositionInterpolator(originalPos, originalPos, GetUInt('stride'), false)
+y is down (DEFAULT_GRAVITY (0, 10), ETHPhysicsSimulator.cpp:26), so it is a sink.
Positions and scale() share m_scaleFactor (scaleEntity 6072 #38-53), so the offset is
6 .esc units at any resolution.
ease_rad is PIb, the constant smoothEnd multiplies its bias by (smoothEnd 313899 #1-4,
sin(v * PIb)): gs2d::math::constant::PIb = 1.570796327f (GameMath.h:40), registered as
a script global at ETHScriptObjRegister.cpp:513-516 and present in the shipped
libApplication.so. Held here as that float in double, as motions.json holds wrap_rad.
The slide is therefore from + (to - from) * sin(ease_rad * min(t / stride, 1)), and it
is `to` once t > stride (getCurrentPos 20104 #7-17).

_note: A lift door (door_lift.ent), as ETHCallback_door_lift runs it: it rises 0.8 of its own
height, eased by smoothEnd over its node's `stride` milliseconds, and it has a status -
0 shut, 1 opening, 2 open, -1 closing. Its switch opens it only from shut and closes it
only from fully raised, so one press lifts it all the way and a release lowers it all
the way. A door closing onto the player kills it. Planning step 133. `ease_rad` is the
button's (PIb, smoothEnd): the interpolator is the same PositionInterpolator.

(ETHScriptObjRegister.generic.cpp:222, :358; ETHSpriteEntity.cpp:652-683). door_lift.ent's
